# Swiss German

> Swiss German is an independent iPhone learning app for readable, contemporary Zürichdeutsch. It uses Standard German prompts, typed recall, progressive hints, and scheduled review.

The app teaches one consistent Zürichdeutsch variety for practical daily situations. It does not present one dialect as the only correct Swiss German.

The course contains 350 practical Zürichdeutsch phrase pairs. Two culture lessons add 18 regional phrase pairs for recognition.

The app is coming soon to the App Store. The complete course works offline and does not require an account.

## Start here

- [Learn Swiss German](https://swiss-german.app/learn-swiss-german/): A practical learning route through one consistent Zürichdeutsch variety.
- [About the project](https://swiss-german.app/about/): Project purpose, teaching method, language scope, and content principles.

## Learning guides

- [Swiss German phrases](https://swiss-german.app/swiss-german-phrases/): Sixteen Zürichdeutsch phrase pairs for common daily situations.
- [I hätt gärn](https://swiss-german.app/phrases/ich-haett-gaern/): Meaning and course examples for a useful request pattern.
- [Swiss German and High German](https://swiss-german.app/swiss-german-vs-high-german/): Practical differences between Zürichdeutsch and Standard German.
- [Zürichdeutsch](https://swiss-german.app/zurich-german/): Dialect scope, usage, spelling, and regional variation.
